selection_policy: Model and post-processing were chosen on public data: DFL (main, leave-one-match-out, with ball-hidden simulations), Metrica and SkillCorner (auxiliary). No labels or tuning from the competition match or its public 5 minutes.
note: Thresholds and their sources live in src/config.py (smooth_choice, slow_buildup, final) and src/keeper_hold.py. The exact values used in a run are copied into run_manifest.json.
